mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my railing needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that your railing needs repair include loose or wobbly posts, corroded or rusted metal components, splintering or rotting wood, and visible damage like cracks or broken sections. If you notice any structural instability or deterioration, it's important to address it promptly to maintain safety. Frasheski Construction can assess these issues to determine the appropriate repair approach.
